notes.title: update 1.2
notes.notes:
Today there was an update 1.2 in which were changed/added:
1. Working motors for the boat( In the screenshot below): 
    1.1 Scrolling screws when moving forward\ backward. 
    1.2 the rotation of the motors when turning left \right.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34898469/1cc770589e60026163479feca884a9d0bbc67bc4.png
2. Changing places on the map:
   2.1 Changed the location of the road and destroyed a bridge on the first map, 
         now there appeared the railroad, and not a few of her compositions.
   2.2 Added the effect of flying dandelions on multiple maps.
   2.3 On one of the cards was also added a road and a railway 
         just destroyed the depot.
   2.4 Minor changes affected one of the winter maps, enhanced 
         fog effect, as well as in the forest now more trees.
